cycle.strategy: insert NULL then restore in same transaction

mapping.datetime_policy: Naive values retain all six microsecond digits. TIMESTAMPTZ treats naive SQLite values as UTC and canonicalizes explicit offsets to UTC; inverse stores UTC naive with six digits. No precision quantization.
mapping.json_policy: One physical JSON decode; SQL NULL distinct from JSON null; numbers use exact Decimal semantics. Reject duplicates, nonfinite numbers, NUL and unpaired surrogates.

normalization: Sorted JSON object keys; ordered introspected arrays. SQLite includes exact pinned DDL SQL to reject unsupported textual/semantic drift. PostgreSQL includes reflected types/constraints/indexes/enums.
postgresql_precision_policy: Only upstream DATETIME(fsp=3) PostgreSQL variant promoted to TIMESTAMP(6) to retain valid six-digit SQLite microseconds; all other fsp and dialects unchanged.
